title: Fix dashboard infinite loading and mobile menu overlay transparency

requirements.text: Fix the Dashboard loading/activation logic so the dashboard never stays stuck in a loading state when the test list API call fails in the frontend. The UI must stop showing the loading skeleton/spinner once the tests query settles (success OR error), and must show a clear error message with a retry action when tests cannot be loaded.

quotes: The dashboard loader stays forever because the API call that fetches tests is failing in the frontend. So the spinner never stops.

acceptanceCriteria: If fetching test configs fails (React Query error), the Dashboard does not remain on the loading skeleton indefinitely.
When the tests query errors, the Dashboard renders an error state (English text) indicating tests could not be loaded and provides a Retry button that re-attempts the fetch.
View activation completion is not blocked by a failed tests fetch (i.e., any view-activation overlay is cleared once queries are settled, not only on success).
When the tests fetch later succeeds after retry, the normal dashboard content renders without requiring a hard refresh.

requirements.text: Fix the mobile menu transparency/blank-background issue by ensuring the Sheet (mobile menu) always renders with a full-screen dimmed overlay/backdrop behind it and correct stacking order. Add a proper overlay element or global CSS overrides so the overlay covers the viewport (inset-0), has a dark semi-transparent background, and sits behind the menu panel but above page content.

quotes: The mobile menu background becomes transparent because the overlay div is missing or has wrong z‑index/inset classes.
Adding a proper overlay div (full‑screen, dark background, correct z‑index) behind the mobile menu.

acceptanceCriteria: Opening the mobile menu on small screens always shows the underlying page dimmed by a non-transparent overlay covering the full viewport.
The menu panel background remains opaque (not transparent) on mobile.
Tapping outside the menu (on the overlay) closes the menu reliably.
The overlay/menu z-index stacking prevents the page from appearing blank/transparent and prevents page-shift artifacts while the menu is open.

requirements.text: Prevent recurrence of the mobile menu rendering issue by hardening the open/close lifecycle: ensure the mobile Sheet state is reset on navigation and when view activation starts, and ensure no intermediate visual state remains if view activation triggers while the menu is open.

quotes: day by day new updates not work properly . if i tell you solve some problem then you create new problem in web site

acceptanceCriteria: Navigating via any mobile menu action closes the menu before switching views.
If view activation starts while the menu is open, the menu closes and the UI returns to a stable non-blank state.
No regressions to desktop navigation behavior.

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only). Fix overlay behavior via composition in app components and/or global CSS in frontend/src/index.css.
Keep changes limited to frontend bug fixes (no backend changes).
nonGoals: Adding new dashboard features beyond loading/error handling (e.g., new filters, new data types).
Redesigning the entire header/navigation; only fix overlay/backdrop and stability issues.
